question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: Amit said, 'I work in a reputed bank.'
options: Amit said that he works in a reputed bank.
Amit said that I worked in a reputed bank.
Amit said that he worked in a reputed bank.
Amit said that he is working in a reputed bank.
answer: Amit said that he worked in a reputed bank.
explanation: चरण 1: Inverted commas हटाकर 'that' लगाएँ। चरण 2: Pronoun 'I' Subject (Amit) के अनुसार 'he' में बदलेगा। चरण 3: Reported Speech Present Simple में है, जो Past Simple (worked) में बदल जाएगा।
trick: Said (Past) + Present Simple = Past Simple (V2). हमेशा V2 खोजें।
tip: Present Simple को Past Simple (V2) में बदलें।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: Priya said to me, 'I am learning French.'
options: Priya told me that she was learning French.
Priya said to me that she is learning French.
Priya told me that I was learning French.
Priya told me that she is learning French.
answer: Priya told me that she was learning French.
explanation: चरण 1: 'said to' को 'told' में बदलें। चरण 2: 'I' Priya के अनुसार 'she' बनेगा। चरण 3: Present Continuous (am learning) को Past Continuous (was learning) में बदलें।
trick: 'said to' हमेशा 'told' में बदलता है। 'am' का 'was' हो जाएगा।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: The manager says, 'The report is ready.'
options: The manager says that the report is ready.
The manager says that the report was ready.
The manager said that the report is ready.
The manager told that the report is ready.
answer: The manager says that the report is ready.
explanation: चरण 1: Reporting Verb 'says' (Present Tense) में है। चरण 2: जब Reporting Verb Present में हो, तो Reported Speech का Tense नहीं बदलता।
trick: यदि बाहर 'says' या 'will say' हो, तो अंदर का Tense (is/are) कभी न बदलें।
tip: Present Reporting Verb = No Tense Change.

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: Rahul said to his sister, 'I have bought a new laptop.'
options: Rahul told his sister that he has bought a new laptop.
Rahul told his sister that he had bought a new laptop.
Rahul told his sister that I had bought a new laptop.
Rahul said his sister that he had bought a new laptop.
answer: Rahul told his sister that he had bought a new laptop.
explanation: चरण 1: 'said to' -> 'told'। चरण 2: 'I' -> 'he' (Rahul के अनुसार)। चरण 3: Present Perfect (have bought) Past Perfect (had bought) में बदल जाएगा।
trick: 'have/has' देखते ही विकल्पों में 'had' खोजें।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: The teacher said, 'The sun rises in the east.'
options: The teacher said that the sun rose in the east.
The teacher said that the sun had risen in the east.
The teacher said that the sun rises in the east.
The teacher told that the sun rises in the east.
answer: The teacher said that the sun rises in the east.
explanation: चरण 1: 'that' लगाएँ। चरण 2: वाक्य एक Universal Truth (सार्वभौमिक सत्य) है। चरण 3: Universal Truth का Tense कभी नहीं बदलता, भले ही Reporting verb 'said' हो।
trick: वैज्ञानिक या सार्वभौमिक सत्य वाले वाक्यों में Tense का बदलाव नहीं होता है।
tip: Universal Truth में Tense न बदलें।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: They said, 'We won the cricket match.'
options: They said that they won the cricket match.
They said that they have won the cricket match.
They said that we had won the cricket match.
They said that they had won the cricket match.
answer: They said that they had won the cricket match.
explanation: चरण 1: 'We' बदलकर 'they' होगा। चरण 2: 'won' (Past Simple) को Past Perfect (had won) में बदला जाता है।
trick: Past Simple (V2) हमेशा Past Perfect (had + V3) में बदलता है।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: He said to me, 'You are my best friend.'
options: He told me that I was his best friend.
He told me that you were my best friend.
He told me that I am his best friend.
He said to me that I was his best friend.
answer: He told me that I was his best friend.
explanation: चरण 1: 'You' (Second Person) Object 'me' के अनुसार 'I' में बदलेगा। चरण 2: 'my' (First Person) Subject 'He' के अनुसार 'his' में बदलेगा। चरण 3: 'are' का 'was' होगा।
trick: SON नियम (123) याद रखें: Second person (You) हमेशा Object (me) के अनुसार बदलता है।
tip: Second Person (You) Object के अनुसार बदलता है।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: She will say, 'I do not like coffee.'
options: She will say that she did not like coffee.
She will say that she does not like coffee.
She will say that I do not like coffee.
She will tell that she does not like coffee.
answer: She will say that she does not like coffee.
explanation: चरण 1: Reporting Verb 'will say' Future Tense में है। चरण 2: इसलिए Reported Speech का Tense (do not) नहीं बदलेगा। चरण 3: 'I' She के अनुसार 'she' बनेगा, जिसके साथ 'does not' लगता है।
trick: Future Reporting verb (will say) = अंदर कोई Tense change नहीं।
tip: Future Reporting Verb = No Tense Change.

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: The boys said, 'We were playing chess.'
options: The boys said that they were playing chess.
The boys said that they had been playing chess.

The boys told that they had been playing chess.
answer: The boys said that they had been playing chess.
explanation: चरण 1: 'We' बदलकर 'they' होगा। चरण 2: Past Continuous (were playing) हमेशा Past Perfect Continuous (had been playing) में बदलता है।
trick: 'was/were + ing' को हमेशा 'had been + ing' में बदलें।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: Mother said to me, 'I baked a cake for you.'
options: Mother told me that she had baked a cake for me.
Mother told me that she baked a cake for me.
Mother told me that she had baked a cake for you.
Mother said to me that she had baked a cake for me.
answer: Mother told me that she had baked a cake for me.

trick: First person Subject के अनुसार और Second person Object के अनुसार बदलता है।
tip: V2 को had + V3 में बदलें।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: Aman says to his friends, 'I will join the party.'
options: Aman tells his friends that he will join the party.
Aman tells his friends that he would join the party.
Aman says to his friends that he will join the party.

trick: 'says to' = 'tells'। Tense मत बदलिए क्योंकि reporting verb present में है।
tip: says to को tells में बदलें।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: The scientist said, 'Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.'

trick: Scientific Fact में कोई भी Tense परिवर्तन न करें।
tip: Scientific Facts का Tense नहीं बदलता।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: She said, 'I can solve this puzzle.'

trick: Modals जैसे 'can' को 'could' में और निकटता वाले शब्द 'this' को 'that' में बदलें।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: He said, 'I may visit London next year.'
options: He said that he may visit London the following year.

He told that he might visit London the following year.

trick: 'next' हमेशा 'the following' में बदलता है। विकल्पों में इसे तुरंत खोजें।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: Anita said to him, 'Your car is blocking my way.'
options: Anita told him that his car was blocking her way.
Anita told him that your car was blocking my way.

trick: Pronouns को ध्यान से बदलें: Your -> him के अनुसार his, My -> Anita के अनुसार her.
tip: Pronouns को SON नियम से बदलें।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: They said, 'We must obey the rules.'
options: They said that they must obey the rules.
They said that they had to obey the rules.
Both A and B are correct in different contexts, but 'had to' is structurally strictly past.
They said that they must have obeyed the rules.
answer: They said that they had to obey the rules.
explanation: चरण 1: 'must' को जब भूतकाल की बाध्यता (past obligation) के रूप में दिखाया जाता है, तो उसे 'had to' में बदलते हैं। 'We' का 'they' हो जाएगा।
trick: 'must' को अक्सर 'had to' में बदला जाता है यदि यह कोई सामान्य नियम न होकर विशेष स्थिति हो।
tip: must को had to में बदल सकते हैं।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: The clerk said, 'I have been working here for ten years.'

trick: 'here' को 'there' में बदलना न भूलें, यह एक आम गलती है।
tip: have been -> had been, here -> there.

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: My father said, 'Honesty pays in the long run.'

trick: Proverbs और Idioms को ज्यों का त्यों (that लगाकर) लिख दिया जाता है।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: She said to me, 'I do not know him.'

trick: Third Person Pronoun (He, She, It, They, Him, His) कभी नहीं बदलते (No Change)।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: The captain said, 'The tournament will start tomorrow.'

trick: हमेशा time words (tomorrow -> the next day) का बदलाव चेक करें।
tip: will -> would, tomorrow -> the next day.

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: He said, 'I was sleeping when the phone rang.'

He said that he had been sleeping when the phone rang.

trick: Past Continuous को Past Perfect Continuous (had been + v-ing) में बदलें।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: Ritu says, 'I went to the market yesterday.'

trick: 'says' होने पर अंदर के Time words (yesterday) और Tense (went) में कोई परिवर्तन न करें।
tip: Says होने पर Tense न बदलें।

trick: Subject 'You' और Possessive 'your' दोनों को एक साथ Object 'her' के अनुसार बदलें।
tip: You/Your को Object के अनुसार बदलें।

tip: used to वाले वाक्यों का Tense न बदलें।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: She said, 'These flowers are beautiful.'

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: The patient said, 'I had taken the medicine before the doctor arrived.'

trick: Past Perfect (had + V3) में कोई Tense परिवर्तन (No Change) नहीं होता है।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: The host said, 'The guests arrived an hour ago.'

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: They said, 'We shall go to the cinema tonight.'

trick: Subject 'they' बनने पर 'shall' का 'should' नहीं, बल्कि 'would' हो जाता है।
tip: They के साथ would का प्रयोग करें।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: Mohan says, 'I am tired.'

trick: बाहर 'says' हो तो अंदर का Tense Past में कभी न ले जाएं।
tip: Says होने पर Tense Change नहीं होता।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form: She said to me, 'I do my work myself.'
options: She told me that she did her work herself.
She told me that she does her work herself.
She told me that she had done her work herself.

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form of the given sentence: He said to us, 'Your performance was excellent.'
options: He told us that our performance was excellent.
He told us that your performance had been excellent.
He told us that our performance had been excellent.
He said to us that our performance had been excellent.
answer: He told us that our performance had been excellent.
explanation: चरण 1: 'said to' -> 'told'। चरण 2: 'Your' Object 'us' के अनुसार 'our' बनेगा। चरण 3: 'was' (Past Simple) को 'had been' (Past Perfect) में बदलें।
trick: मुख्य क्रिया के रूप में आये 'was/were' को 'had been' में बदलना अनिवार्य है।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech form of the given sentence: She said, 'I have been reading since morning.'
options: She said that she has been reading since morning.
She said that she had been reading since morning.
She told that she had been reading since morning.
She said that she was reading since morning.
answer: She said that she had been reading since morning.
explanation: चरण 1: 'have been reading' (Present Perfect Continuous) को 'had been reading' (Past Perfect Continuous) में बदलें। चरण 2: 'I' को Subject 'She' के अनुसार 'she' में बदलें।
trick: 'have been' देखते ही उसे 'had been' में बदल दें और 'since/for' के समय को वैसे ही रहने दें।
